target_customer: Large enterprises that need Scope 3 supplier emissions data; the enterprise pays and suppliers get tools free
problem: Enterprises struggle to collect emissions data from their suppliers. Aklimate gives each supplier free carbon management tools in exchange for their emissions data.
business_model: Enterprise pays for supplier carbon tools; suppliers use them free in exchange for emissions data

founders.name: Harry Humfrey
founders.background_notes: YC page: Bain Energy and Natural Resources practice; competed for Great Britain in equestrian sport.

founders.name: Mark Fischel
founders.background_notes: YC page: B2B SaaS at Mastercard.

founders.name: Will Taylor
founders.background_notes: YC page: early engineer working with the GitHub co-founders on their second venture.

competitors.name: Watershed
competitors.what: Carbon accounting and decarbonization platform for enterprises including supplier data collection; the YC description calls Aklimate a Watershed-lite for each supplier
competitors.traction_then: Reached a 1 billion dollar valuation in Feb 2022
competitors.funding_then: 70M Series B co-led by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins announced 2022-02-08; 14M Series A in Feb 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Carbon accounting for suppliers is mostly standard SaaS plus emissions factor databases; the hard parts are data quality and supplier onboarding rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Collected supplier emissions data could compound, but the same supplier portal approach was already offered by larger funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded carbon accounting platforms already offered supplier portals. No source shows Aklimate being copied or bought; PitchBook lists it as out of business.

market_need_then: Scope 3 supplier emissions were a growing disclosure requirement and Watershed raised 70M at a 1B valuation in Feb 2022, per ESG Today. No Aklimate customer data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used getaklimate.com (prefixed domain) per the YC page; PitchBook says formerly known as Club Zero Carbon.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches found only trademark records for similar spellings and database profiles; the name is a respelling of a common word and is easily confused with Acclimate marks.

outcome_analysis: Aklimate was a three founder London team that gave suppliers free carbon tools in exchange for emissions data, entering a market where Watershed had just raised 70 million dollars. PitchBook reports about 1.25 million dollars raised and a liquidation, but no shutdown post-mortem exists, so the cause is not public; the failure factors reflect the funded competition and small raise rather than a stated reason.
notes: Failure factors are inferred from context, not stated by any source; cause of shutdown not public. Both rounds rest on single databases (PitchBook seed 251K; VCBacked pre-seed 500K, March 2022, YC led). PitchBook total raised is 1.25M, which exceeds the two recorded rounds, so a gap of about 500K is unaccounted for. PitchBook liquidation status is a single database claim with no date. Company site returned 503 so it was not read. Founders' education not found. Founding year conflicts: PitchBook 2020, YC 2021.
